newsitem.title: UK: BT raises prices for some information lines.
newsitem.headline: BT raises prices for some information lines.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc on Friday said it would raise the prices for calls to some information and entertainment lines operated on "premium rate" numbers such as 0891, 0839 and 0660.

From October 8 this year, calls to numbers on the 0891 code will increase from 39 pence a minute to 45 pence during evenings, at night and at weekends, and from 49 pence to 50 penec a minute during the day.
The new prices reflect increased payments which BT makes to the providers of these services, the telecom firm said.

Calls made from BT phones to information services operated by Mercury Communications Ltd on 0839 and 0660 codes will be raised to 49 pence per minute at all times from a current tariff of 39 pence at night time, evenings and weekends.

From October 14 the charge for calls from BT phones to Vodata information and entertainment services on 0336 and 03311 codes will also change -- calls to 0336 numbers will cost 45 pence per minute instead of 39 pence at evening, night and weekends and 50 pence instead of 49 pence during the day.
Calls to 03311 numbers will cost one pound per minute at all times instead of 1.50 stg.
